title_zh: 官方边界发布后的独立复算工作簿
title_en: Independent recalculation workbook after official boundary release
boundary_notice_zh: 本工作簿只登记未来在官方边界发布后如何独立复算；当前没有官方边界输入，不改变现有临时几何，也不产生官方红线、法定指标、实施授权或政府背书。
boundary_notice_en: This workbook registers how to perform an independent recalculation after an official boundary release. No official boundary input is currently available; it does not change provisional geometry or create an official redline, statutory metric, implementation authorisation or government endorsement.

activation.activation_trigger_zh: 只有在组织方或正式数据持有人发布可核验的总体边界、三处重点区 polygon 及其版本/坐标/来源元数据后，才可将本工作簿从 not_activated 切换为 intake_pending。
activation.activation_trigger_en: Move this workbook from not_activated to intake_pending only after the organizer or source-of-record publishes a verifiable site boundary, the three key-area polygons and version/CRS/provenance metadata.
activation.current_reason_for_hold_zh: 当前来源登记只包含临时粗略范围；官方 polygon 尚未进入本包。
activation.current_reason_for_hold_en: The current source register contains only provisional rough extents; official polygons are not in this package.
do_not_do_now: replace geometry/site_boundary.geojson with an inferred or hand-redrawn boundary
rename provisional areas as official redlines
publish precise official area, FAR, height, density or parcel controls
claim external protocol level, field performance or implementation authorisation
use a news map, basemap, screenshot or geocoder result as a substitute for the source-of-record polygon

accepted_formats: another lossless vector export with an accompanying schema and CRS record
required_inputs.expected_geometry: one named site feature or an explicitly documented multipart site feature

accepted_formats: another lossless vector export with an accompanying schema and CRS record
required_inputs.expected_geometry: three uniquely identified polygons or an explicitly documented multipart representation

minimum_metadata: who published or supplied the data
what the boundary covers and what it does not cover
license, access basis and permitted reuse
whether the data is informational, planning-control or another official status

conditionally_required_inputs.required_when: a claim concerns FAR, height, density, setbacks, parcel controls, heritage, road redlines, utilities, fire or another statutory/specialist condition
examples: official road/rail or transport constraint layer
official heritage, fire, accessibility or utility layer
official building or land-use layer with a defined vintage
conditionally_required_inputs.absence_policy_zh: 缺失时将相应指标维持为 unknown 或 conceptual；不得由边界、底图或概念图形推导。
conditionally_required_inputs.absence_policy_en: If absent, keep the related metric unknown or conceptual; do not infer it from the boundary, basemap or concept geometry.

forbidden_substitutions: a hand-drawn redline based on a screenshot
a geocoded point buffer or parcel guess
a web basemap or satellite image without a source-of-record polygon
a boundary copied from a different publication vintage
a polygon whose CRS, unit, scope or checksum cannot be recovered

baseline_snapshot.source_policy: The snapshot freezes the current package before any future official input is ingested.

baseline_metrics.hold_reason: The official site area and approved floor-area controls are not available.

geometry_acceptance_tests.pass_criteria_zh: 能从发布页、档案或组织方登记回到 source-of-record，并记录发布者、版本、时间、许可与用途范围。
geometry_acceptance_tests.pass_criteria_en: The source-of-record can be reached through a publication page, archive or organizer register, with publisher, version, dates, license and scope recorded.

geometry_acceptance_tests.pass_criteria_zh: 原始文件与登记元数据给出 CRS/EPSG、线性单位；等面积复算坐标仅用于派生副本。
geometry_acceptance_tests.pass_criteria_en: The raw file and metadata declare CRS/EPSG and linear units; an equal-area CRS is used only for a derived processing copy.

geometry_acceptance_tests.pass_criteria_zh: 几何闭合且有效，无自交、零面积碎片或未记录的重叠；修复动作保留原始 hash 与修复日志。
geometry_acceptance_tests.pass_criteria_en: Geometries are closed and valid, with no self-intersection, zero-area fragment or unexplained overlap; any repair preserves the raw hash and records the repair.

geometry_acceptance_tests.pass_criteria_zh: 总体边界、重点区与派生图层的范围和单位可解释；面积结果经过单位核算。
geometry_acceptance_tests.pass_criteria_en: The site, key areas and derived layers have explainable extents and units; area results pass a unit sanity check.

geometry_acceptance_tests.pass_criteria_zh: 已说明单一或多部件总体边界语义；不存在因合并、溶解或重复要素造成的面积双计。
geometry_acceptance_tests.pass_criteria_en: Single-part or multipart site semantics are documented; dissolve, merge or duplicate features cannot double-count area.

geometry_acceptance_tests.title_zh: 重点区落在总体边界内
geometry_acceptance_tests.pass_criteria_zh: 三处重点区 ID 唯一、数量符合发布记录，并完全落在总体边界内；若为跨界区必须有发布方解释。
geometry_acceptance_tests.pass_criteria_en: The three key-area IDs are unique, the count matches the release record and each polygon is contained by the site; a cross-boundary area requires source-of-record explanation.

geometry_acceptance_tests.pass_criteria_zh: 总体边界、重点区、专题图层与指标快照均记录 vintage；不同版本的混用有明确理由并由复核者签字。
geometry_acceptance_tests.pass_criteria_en: The site, key areas, thematic layers and metric snapshots record their vintage; any cross-vintage use is justified and signed off by the reviewer.

geometry_acceptance_tests.pass_criteria_zh: 处理前保存原始文件、SHA-256、下载/取得时间及登记表；所有派生副本指向原始 hash。
geometry_acceptance_tests.pass_criteria_en: Before processing, retain the raw file, SHA-256, retrieval time and intake record; every derived copy points to the raw hash.

geometry_acceptance_tests.pass_criteria_zh: 只对发布或明确授权的图层复算；缺少官方控制图层时不推导 FAR、高度、密度、权属、消防、交通或文保结论。
geometry_acceptance_tests.pass_criteria_en: Only released or explicitly authorized layers are recalculated; without official control layers, do not infer FAR, height, density, ownership, fire, transport or heritage conclusions.

metric_recalculation_contract.rounding_rule: retain full calculation precision; display rounding must be documented
metric_recalculation_contract.interpretation_zh: 这是发布数据范围内的几何面积，不自动等于法定建设用地面积或可开发面积。
metric_recalculation_contract.interpretation_en: This is the geometric area of the released data scope; it is not automatically statutory developable or buildable area.

metric_recalculation_contract.rounding_rule: integer count with an ID-to-name reconciliation table
metric_recalculation_contract.interpretation_zh: 只核对发布的重点区数量与身份，不将数量解释为优先级、批准状态或开发强度。
metric_recalculation_contract.interpretation_en: This reconciles the released key-area count and identity; it does not imply priority, approval or development intensity.

metric_recalculation_contract.rounding_rule: retain full calculation precision; record clipping and exclusions
metric_recalculation_contract.interpretation_zh: 若建筑图层仍是概念图层，结果只能标为 conceptual_clipped；不能借正式边界把概念建筑面积升级为现状或法定建筑指标。
metric_recalculation_contract.interpretation_en: If the building layer remains conceptual, the result is conceptual_clipped; an official boundary cannot upgrade concept building area into existing or statutory building data.

metric_recalculation_contract.interpretation_zh: 只有绿色空间图层的来源、语义和 vintage 也被确认时，才可讨论其发布范围内面积；不能把设计意向等同现状绿地。
metric_recalculation_contract.interpretation_en: Discuss area within the released scope only when the green-space layer's provenance, semantics and vintage are also confirmed; design intent is not existing green space.

metric_recalculation_contract.rounding_rule: store unrounded value and separately store display value
metric_recalculation_contract.interpretation_zh: 比例必须同时携带分子/分母来源与范围标签，不称为法定绿地率或绩效结果。
metric_recalculation_contract.interpretation_en: The ratio must carry numerator/denominator sources and scope labels; do not call it a statutory green ratio or performance result.

metric_recalculation_contract.rounding_rule: store unrounded value and separately store display value
metric_recalculation_contract.interpretation_zh: 比例只能表达经过边界裁切的图层关系，不称为现状公共服务覆盖率或实施绩效。
metric_recalculation_contract.interpretation_en: The ratio expresses the clipped layer relationship only; it is not existing public-service coverage or implementation performance.

metric_recalculation_contract.rounding_rule: do not display a number when any required control input is absent
metric_recalculation_contract.interpretation_zh: 正式边界本身不提供 FAR；没有官方控制和总建筑面积就维持 unknown。
metric_recalculation_contract.interpretation_en: An official boundary does not provide FAR; retain unknown without official controls and total floor-area data.

outputs: read-only copy of current metrics and provisional geometry
workflow_steps.pass_evidence: A dated baseline record and hashes are attached to the run record.
Every required field in the input contract is complete and independently retrievable.
GEO-001 through GEO-009 have pass/hold decisions and named reviewers.

workflow_steps.title_zh: 替换边界输入但保留原始文件
workflow_steps.title_en: Replace the boundary input while retaining raw bytes
workflow_steps.pass_evidence: The old provisional files remain recoverable; the new files are explicitly versioned and linked to raw hashes.
Each metric records formula, numerator/denominator source, scope, status, old value, new value and delta.

outputs: updated figures, pages and drawings where needed
workflow_steps.pass_evidence: Every affected artifact is updated, explicitly marked unchanged with a reason, or held from publication.
Each boundary-dependent claim has source, snapshot, metric, responsible role and stop condition; no claim exceeds its input.

workflow_steps.title_en: Run local gates and human spot checks
workflow_steps.pass_evidence: All deterministic gates pass, bilingual pages agree, and a human reviewer records the final intake decision.

impacted_artifacts.action: replace only after GEO-001 through GEO-005 pass; retain the old provisional file in the run archive
replace only after GEO-006 passes; preserve ID/name reconciliation
clip and rehash if the layer is in scope; otherwise leave geometry unchanged and mark derived metric conceptual_clipped or unknown
reclip/recompute only when its vintage and semantics are documented
reclip/recompute only when its vintage and semantics are documented
audit all overlays; do not relabel concept land use as official zoning
reconcile phase references and hold any moved or unmatched feature
audit overlays; do not infer road redlines or transport approval from boundary change
populate only from supplied official/professional evidence; an empty layer remains empty

impacted_artifacts.dependency: all boundary-dependent geometry and layer status
impacted_artifacts.action: write old value, new value, delta, formula, scope and confidence; preserve unknown where inputs are absent

impacted_artifacts.dependency: maps, labels, areas, ratios and boundary-dependent annotations
impacted_artifacts.action: identify each figure as update, unchanged-with-reason, or hold; regenerate only from the new structured data

impacted_artifacts.dependency: narrative metrics, maps, caveats and evidence links
impacted_artifacts.action: update claims and caveats; retain concept-only disclosures where thematic layers remain conceptual

impacted_artifacts.dependency: interactive metric cards and map labels
impacted_artifacts.action: update boundary-dependent values and run bilingual/offline visual checks
re-export affected boards and visually inspect first pages and map labels
append a new boundary release snapshot and re-evaluate every affected claim
refresh only after content changes are complete; then refresh self-check as the final local step

evidence_chain_template.boundary_dependent_claim_rule_zh: 任何提及范围、面积、比例、重点区位置、分期或空间映射的主张，都必须绑定新官方输入的 source/snapshot，并说明其余图层是否仍为概念层。
evidence_chain_template.boundary_dependent_claim_rule_en: Every claim about extent, area, ratio, key-area location, phasing or spatial mapping must bind to the new official input source/snapshot and state whether the remaining layers are still conceptual.

roles.responsibility_zh: 发布或确认官方边界、重点区及其版本、范围、坐标与使用边界。
roles.responsibility_en: Publishes or confirms the official site/key-area data, version, scope, CRS and use boundaries.

roles.responsibility_zh: 登记输入、保留原始字节、执行派生复算、更新本包并披露状态。
roles.responsibility_en: Registers inputs, preserves raw bytes, performs derived recalculation, updates the package and discloses status.

roles.responsibility_zh: 独立检查 CRS、几何有效性、包含关系、版本一致性与面积算法。
roles.responsibility_en: Independently checks CRS, geometry validity, containment, vintage consistency and area calculations.

roles.responsibility_zh: 复核主张—来源—快照—指标—责任角色—停止条件链条。
判断专题图层的专业语义与是否足以支持规划、交通、文保或实施相关表述。
roles.responsibility_en: Assesses thematic-layer semantics and whether they support planning, transport, heritage or implementation language.
roles.decision_right: professional scope recommendation, not government authorization

roles.responsibility_zh: 抽查中英文地图、数值、标注、图纸与离线页面是否同步。
roles.responsibility_en: Spot-checks bilingual maps, values, labels, drawings and offline pages for consistency.

roles.responsibility_zh: 决定是否接收更新，不将接收等同获奖、发布、实施授权或政府背书。
roles.responsibility_en: Decides whether to intake the update without equating intake with award, publication, implementation authorization or endorsement.

stop_conditions.trigger_zh: 缺少 source-of-record、版本、CRS、范围、许可或原始 hash。
stop_conditions.trigger_en: Source-of-record, version, CRS, scope, license or raw hash is missing.
stop_conditions.action_zh: 不激活工作簿；保持 provisional_only，暂停边界替换和官方口径。
stop_conditions.action_en: Do not activate the workbook; keep provisional_only and hold replacement or official wording.

stop_conditions.trigger_zh: 几何无效、重点区越界、版本混用、单位不明或无法解释修复。
stop_conditions.trigger_en: Invalid geometry, key-area escape, mixed vintages, unknown units or unexplained repair occurs.
stop_conditions.action_zh: 冻结新输入，保留原始文件，回退到 provisional_only。
stop_conditions.action_en: Freeze the new input, retain raw bytes and return to provisional_only.

stop_conditions.trigger_zh: 把裁切后的概念图层说成现状/法定数据，或使用边界推导缺失的控制指标。
stop_conditions.trigger_en: A clipped concept layer is presented as existing/statutory data, or missing controls are inferred from the boundary.
stop_conditions.action_zh: 将指标降级为 conceptual、unknown 或 provisional，并暂停受影响主张。
stop_conditions.action_en: Downgrade the metric to conceptual, unknown or provisional and hold affected claims.

stop_conditions.trigger_zh: 中英文页面、图纸、图例、指标或边界标识不一致，或概念状态标签缺失。
stop_conditions.trigger_en: Bilingual pages, drawings, legends, metrics or boundary labels disagree, or concept-status labels are missing.
stop_conditions.action_zh: 不请求复审；先更新所有受影响资产并重新抽查。
stop_conditions.action_en: Do not request review; update affected assets and repeat visual checks first.

stop_conditions.trigger_zh: manifest、schema、证据链校验、自检或包体积门任一失败。
stop_conditions.trigger_en: Manifest, schema, evidence-chain check, self-check or package-size gate fails.
stop_conditions.action_zh: 修复或回退，不提交为 review-ready。
stop_conditions.action_en: Fix or revert; do not mark the package review-ready.

stop_conditions.trigger_zh: 复算更新把 optional_crosswalk_concept_only 变成外部等级、正式采用、实测性能、部署授权或官方背书。
stop_conditions.trigger_en: The recalculation update turns optional_crosswalk_concept_only into an external level, formal adoption, measured performance, deployment authorization or endorsement.
stop_conditions.action_zh: 拒绝该表述，恢复安全边界并重新复核证据链。
stop_conditions.action_en: Reject the wording, restore the safety boundary and recheck the evidence chain.

state_machine.meaning_zh: 没有可核验官方输入；当前状态。
state_machine.meaning_en: No verifiable official input exists; current state.
state_machine.transition_condition: required official inputs and metadata are published

state_machine.meaning_zh: 输入已收到但尚未通过来源、几何和版本门。
state_machine.meaning_en: Inputs are received but have not passed provenance, geometry and vintage gates.
state_machine.transition_condition: GEO-001 through GEO-009 receive pass decisions, or any hard stop returns the work to hold

state_machine.meaning_zh: 官方输入的范围和几何通过工作包复核，但尚未完成所有派生指标和视觉更新。
state_machine.meaning_en: Official inputs pass the workbook's scope and geometry review; dependent metrics and visual updates are not yet complete.
state_machine.transition_condition: raw hashes, geometry QA and source-of-record record are complete

state_machine.meaning_zh: 指标、证据链、受影响交付物和本地门均已更新；等待维护者决定。
state_machine.meaning_en: Metrics, evidence chain, impacted deliverables and local gates are updated; maintainer decision is pending.
state_machine.transition_condition: all required validation and visual spot checks pass

state_machine.meaning_zh: 仅表示仓库接收该更新，不表示获奖、画廊发布、实施授权或政府背书。
state_machine.meaning_en: Repository intake only; not an award, gallery publication, implementation authorization or government endorsement.
state_machine.transition_condition: maintainer or organizer records an intake decision

state_machine.meaning_zh: 至少一个输入、指标、证据链、视觉或边界安全门未通过。
state_machine.meaning_en: At least one input, metric, evidence, visual or boundary-safety gate has failed.
state_machine.transition_condition: the failed condition is corrected and the relevant gate is rerun

required_outputs: raw official boundary and key-area files or retrievable archive references
input intake record with source, version, CRS, scope, license and SHA-256
old/new metric snapshot and delta table
validation logs and bilingual visual spot-check record
required_disclosures_zh: 官方边界发布了什么范围、没有发布什么范围
哪些指标由官方输入派生，哪些仍由概念图层派生，哪些仍 unknown
本次更新不构成外部协议等级、实施授权、政府承诺或官方背书
required_disclosures_en: what the official boundary covers and does not cover
which metrics derive from official inputs, which still derive from concept layers and which remain unknown
this update does not assert an external protocol level, implementation authorization, government commitment or endorsement
output_contract.retention_rule: Keep raw inputs, hashes, processing notes and prior provisional baseline recoverable; never overwrite the only copy of the source-of-record input.

review_questions: Can another reviewer retrieve the exact official bytes and reproduce the source hash?
Does every official input state its CRS, unit, scope, vintage and permitted use?
Are key-area IDs and containment relationships explicitly reconciled?
Does each changed metric show old value, new value, delta, formula and source scope?
Did any concept layer silently become official because the boundary changed?
Were all maps, captions, report pages, drawings and bilingual labels audited?
Does the updated evidence chain still bind claim, source, snapshot, metric, role and stop condition?
Does the package remain optional_crosswalk_concept_only and free of implementation claims?
